claims: Paul George was suspended for 25 games without pay on January 31, 2026, for violating the terms of the NBA/NBPA Anti-Drug Program.
According to reports, the suspension was triggered by a failed test after Paul George took an "improper medication" to treat a mental health issue.
Paul George linked the mental health issue to frustration over his recovery from an earlier knee injury.
Paul George admitted to taking the substance.
Paul George stated, "I made a mistake at that moment."
Paul George noted the pressure he felt as a leader with the Philadelphia 76ers.
The specific substance involved was not publicly named by the NBA or Paul George.
The 25-game suspension cost Paul George approximately $11.7 million of his salary.
After serving the suspension, Paul George returned to the Philadelphia 76ers' lineup in March 2026.
